assembly.sourceCondition: WornPathA is a compacted-soil shortcut that approaches the south edge of DanchiPlaza. The legacy generated edging continued seven 0.60 m-pitch precast modules beyond the plaza boundary even though the soil surface is vertically hidden beneath the higher plaza slab there, producing two curb rails across the paved field.
components: two modular precast concrete edging runs
open path mouth before the paved plaza
assembly.manufacture: Individual precast concrete edging blocks are installed as modular units on prepared bedding/subbase. The rendered fallback models only visible block geometry; buried bedding is represented by the installation datum and metadata rather than exposed decorative geometry.
assembly.mounting: Each retained edging block is embedded 10 mm below the compacted-soil top and stands approximately 70 mm above it. The two runs straddle the soil path with an approximately 5 mm inner interface gap. The run terminates on the last whole module before the plaza instead of carrying hidden-path edging into the paved field.
assembly.interfaces: soil-to-curb inner seam, grass-to-curb outer face, modular block joints, and an open 356 mm transition from the final whole block to the plaza edge
assembly.orientation: long axis north-south; the path approaches the plaza from negative Z toward positive Z
assembly.exposure: top faces are sun/rain exposed; lower vertical faces receive soil splash; inner seams retain fine sediment; the open mouth receives pedestrian wear
assembly.aging: Weathering is cause-based: lower-face splash, joint sediment and modest top-edge wear may occur. No random crack field, painted contact shadow or identical copied stain is allowed.
assembly.geometryVsMaterial: Block dimensions, chamfer, module spacing, path-to-curb gap, termination setback and the paved/soil height relationship are geometry. Aggregate, micro-roughness, subtle color variation, moisture response and UV aging belong to the material/shader.
assembly.periodAuthenticity: A modest modular concrete edge beside an informal pedestrian shortcut is treated as period-plausible fallback infrastructure. No claim is made that these exact dimensions reproduce a specific housing estate or historical product.

material.microstructure: dense precast cement paste with small aggregate; edge response comes from physical chamfer rather than painted highlights
material.wetResponse: if a later wet benchmark is authored, albedo may darken and roughness may fall locally according to real exposure; the current dry midsummer benchmark remains dry
material.uvAging: small warm/gray drift and modest upper-face fade only; no repeated identical dirt stamp
material.angularFresnelResponse: rough dielectric F0 near 0.04 with broad grazing lift; never metallic or mirror-like

lodPolicy.lod0: retain the seven whole authored chamfered modules per side and their physical joints
lodPolicy.lod1: retain the same installed module silhouette; no cutover is permitted until rendered evidence proves a cheaper representation does not pop
lodPolicy.lod2: retain the same installed module silhouette because the corrected assembly is only fourteen visible modules and avoids a geometry-changing transition
lodPolicy.lod3: retain the same installed module silhouette; distance optimization may be introduced only with temporal evidence proving no visible pop
lodPolicy.transitionPolicy: The generated fallback intentionally spends a small fixed renderer cost to eliminate an unverified LOD shape change. Any future authored replacement must provide explicit LOD0/1/2/3 evidence.

researchBasis.source: Yokohama City park/green-space standard drawings, current reference edition
researchBasis.referenceUse: Installation principle only: modular concrete edging/curb blocks are placed on mortar/base layers and treated as discrete manufactured units. Current drawings show common 600 mm modules; exact present-day joint/base dimensions are not asserted as circa-2000 site facts.

evidencePlan: hero/ground_contact 100% crop: confirm the worn-soil shortcut opens into the plaza and no parallel curb rails continue across paving
oblique/vegetation_grounding 100% crop where visible: confirm the final module has a manufactured end face, believable soil/grass contact and no floating edge
grazing/material_grazing if the path mouth enters frame: verify rough dielectric concrete, physical chamfer and no painted highlight
temporal evidence: confirm no renderer re-enables suppressed legacy modules and no curb silhouette pop appears
criticalFailPrevention: no active legacy curb geometry may project into the DanchiPlaza paved field
no retained curb renderer may use Unity primitive mesh geometry
no claim of visual quality without actual rendered evidence
